v1.8.3 - The network gateway reconnects on its own again

A TCP/network gateway (ESPHome `stream_server`, ser2net) now recovers by itself after its peer has been away. One beta build, confirmed on the reporter's ESPHome bridge. Closes #42.

### Update if you use a network gateway

A reconnect that timed out stopped the reconnect loop for good. The socket was kept before it was connected, so a timed-out connect left one behind that had never been connected, and the reader took its timeouts for "no data yet": it never noticed there was no transport and never retried, and the add-on sat dead until *Restart services*. A socket is now only kept once it is connected, and a failed attempt is just an attempt.

### Also fixed

- The reconnect backoff no longer resets on a bare TCP handshake. A peer that accepts and hangs up at once, an ESP32 out of heap for instance, was retried about once a second for hours. A session now has to carry a byte or last 30 seconds to count, otherwise the backoff grows to 30 s.
- The "still waiting for data" heartbeat measures real time instead of counting reads, and no longer appears while no transport exists.

Full changelog: [addon/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ESDN83/HA_enoceanmqtt-addon-ui/blob/main/addon/CHANGELOG.md)

Thanks to @salzrat for the report, the log analysis and the field test.
